plate_length = 80.0

taper_length = 20.0
hole_diameter = 6.0

chamfer_distance = 0.5
slot_width = 6.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (plate_length - taper_length, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (plate_length, plate_width / 2))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (plate_length - taper_length, plate_width))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, plate_width))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

solid = p.part

slot_box = Pos(plate_length / 2, slot_center_y, plate_thickness / 2) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, plate_thickness)

    hole_y = plate_width / 2 + (i - 1) * hole_spacing
    solid = solid - Pos(hole_x, hole_y, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)
